_readme: Demo venue layout for AI Crowd Guardian, based on the Circuit de Monaco (Monaco Grand Prix). Each zone now carries real-world latitude/longitude. coordinate_source is 'verified' for points sourced directly from Wikipedia/geohack references (see coordinate_reference block below) and 'estimated' for zones interpolated along the harbourfront between verified anchors, since individual gate/grandstand positions are not independently published as GPS data anywhere public. Treat 'estimated' points as good enough to plot on a map for a demo, not as surveyed truth - replace with a real GIS trace of the circuit if this goes past hackathon stage. capacity_per_min, distance_m and width_m remain illustrative placeholders to tune before the demo.
venue_name: Circuit de Monaco - Monaco Grand Prix

coordinate_reference.note: Verified anchor points, each independently sourced. All other zone coordinates are estimated by interpolating along the harbourfront relative to these.

anchors.name: Start/Finish line, Boulevard Albert 1er
anchors.source: Wikipedia geohack, Monaco GP race articles

anchors.name: La Condamine / Port Hercule (harbour ward centroid)
Casino de Monte-Carlo, Place du Casino

zones.name: Gate 1 - Le Rocher (General Admission)
zones.notes: Entrance for Le Rocher, a hillside general-admission viewing area outside the circuit itself, near Sainte Devote.

zones.name: Sainte Devote (Turn 1)
zones.notes: Circuit's narrowest, most accident-prone corner. Pinch point between Gate 1 / Zone Z crowds and the harbour-side grandstands.

zones.name: Zone Z (General Admission)
zones.notes: Unreserved standing zone near the Tabac corner, close to Sainte Devote.

zones.name: Monaco Monte-Carlo Train Station
zones.notes: Largest single crowd-injection point. Feeds directly into Gate 8 via a pedestrian tunnel. Strong candidate for a 'train arrival' shock event.

zones.name: Gate 8 - Grandstand K1-K3
zones.notes: Below the train station stairs. Grandstand K overlooks Port Hercule between the Tabac corner and the Piscine chicane.

zones.name: Gate 7 - Grandstand K4-K6
zones.notes: Second entrance for the K grandstand, closer to the Louis Chiron / Piscine chicane end.

zones.name: Port Hercule Harbour Promenade
zones.notes: Main pedestrian spine along the harbour, connecting Gates 2, 7 and 8 and Grandstands K, N, O, P, V. Coordinate is the La Condamine ward centroid; this zone is a line in reality, not a point - split it into segments if the digital twin needs finer resolution. Highest-traffic corridor in the venue.

zones.name: Gate 2 - Grandstands N, O, P, V
zones.notes: Harbourfront grandstands built over the water, facing the Piscine (swimming pool) section.

zones.name: Casino Square - Grandstand B
zones.notes: Viewing area at the Casino corner, Place du Casino. High footfall from cafes, restaurants and the fan zone walk.

zones.name: Fan Zone - Place d'Armes
zones.notes: Free public fan zone with big screen, food and drink. No ticket required, so inflow is the least predictable zone in the venue.

zones.name: Gate 3 - Grandstands T1-T3
zones.notes: Entrance near the Nouvelle Chicane / pit straight hospitality stands.

zones.name: Gate 4 - Grandstands X1-X2
zones.notes: Entrance on Rue Princess Caroline, west side of town.

zones.name: Gate 5 - Grandstand L
zones.notes: Grandstand L overlooks the exit of the Piscine chicane, facing Le Rocher.

zones.name: Fontvieille Egress / Post-Race Exit
zones.notes: Main post-event egress route away from the harbour, toward parking and the Fontvieille district (west of Monaco-Ville).
